description: This file defines an internal structure CoarseStopwatch for timing durations with low overhead, using environment tick count as the timing source. It provides methods to start, stop, reset, and measure elapsed time.

classes.name: CoarseStopwatch
classes.description: A non-allocating, coarse-grained stopwatch for measuring durations with millisecond accuracy, suitable for performance monitoring within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: StartNew
methods.description: Creates a new stopwatch instance and starts it, optionally with a specified elapsed time.

methods.name: FromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a new stopwatch instance from a specific timestamp.

methods.name: GetTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current environment tick count as the timestamp.

methods.name: FromTimestamp (overload)
methods.description: Creates a new, stopped stopwatch with specific start and end timestamps.

methods.name: GetRawTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the raw internal timestamp value.

methods.name: Restart
methods.description: Resets and starts the stopwatch immediately.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Stops the stopwatch and resets elapsed time to zero.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the stopwatch, recording the elapsed duration.
